# IBM Db2 TechX Summit 2026 — Project Submission

## 1. Project Overview
- **Project Title:** InternScrap: IBM Db2-Powered Internship Aggregator & Lifecycle Tracker
- **Project Slug:** `submissions/internscrap/`
- **Short Description:** An automated tech internship aggregator and application pipeline tracker demonstrating enterprise relational modeling, performance indexing, and analytical views on IBM Db2.
- **Problem Solved & Target Audience:** Solves the challenge of scattered internship postings and unorganized application pipelines for engineering and data science students by centralizing opportunities in IBM Db2 with automated scrapers and candidate lifecycle tracking.

## 2. Team Information
- **Team Name:** InternScrap Core
- **Team Members:**
| Full Name | GitHub Username | Email / Role |
| Aryanshh Srivastava | @Aryanshh | aryanshh08sri@gmail.com / Full Stack & Data Systems Engineer |

## 3. IBM Db2 Integration Summary
- **IBM Db2 Edition / Environment:** IBM Db2 Community Edition (Docker: `icr.io/db2_community/db2`) / IBM Db2 on Cloud
- **How IBM Db2 is Used:** Acts as the primary persistence and analytical engine with normalized tables (`COMPANIES`, `INTERNSHIPS`, `SKILLS`, `INTERNSHIP_SKILLS`, `APPLICATIONS`), cascading foreign keys, lookup indexes, and analytical views (`V_ACTIVE_INTERNSHIPS`, `V_TOP_IN_DEMAND_SKILLS`, `V_APPLICATION_FUNNEL`, `V_UPCOMING_DEADLINES`).
- **Db2 Connector / Framework Integration:** Official `ibm_db` Python driver with parameterized queries and fallback simulation.
- **Schema & Data Stored:** Scraped tech internships, normalized tech skills catalog, company metadata and tiering, and applicant status board (`WISHLIST`, `APPLIED`, `INTERVIEWING`, `OFFER`).
- **Steps to Verify:**
  1. `cd submissions/internscrap && pip install -r requirements.txt`
  2. `python -m src.internscrap init-db`
  3. `python -m src.internscrap scrape --source sample`
  4. `python -m src.internscrap list`
  5. `python -m src.internscrap stats`
  6. `pytest submissions/internscrap/tests/`

## 4. Technology Stack
- **Programming Languages:** Python, SQL
- **Frameworks & Libraries:** `ibm_db`, `requests`, `beautifulsoup4`, `tabulate`, `pytest`
- **AI / LLM Framework:** None (Pure Data Engineering & Relational Analytics)

## 5. Submission Verification Checklist
- [x] **Folder Structure:** Placed in `submissions/internscrap/` copied from template.
- [x] **Naming Conventions:** Kebab-case `internscrap` matching folder and branch name.
- [x] **Complete Documentation:** Both `README.md` and `architecture.md` are completely filled out.
- [x] **Metadata File:** `submission.json` is completed and valid JSON.
- [x] **No Secrets or Credentials:** `.env.example` contains placeholders only.
- [x] **Tested Setup Instructions:** 6/6 pytest tests passing and `validate_submission.py` passed.
- [x] **Scope Isolation:** Only touches files in `submissions/internscrap/`.
